shellCommands.command: find /workspace -type f -not -path "*/node_modules/*" -not -path "*/.git/*" | head -100
git diff package.json && echo "=== eval ===" && cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs && echo "=== next ver ===" && cat node_modules/next/package.json 2>/dev/null | head -5

ls node_modules/react/ && echo "=== next react bundled ===" && ls node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/ 2>/dev/null && grep -rn "viewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.js 2>/dev/null | head -5

cd /workspace; grep -rno "viewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.js | head; echo "=== config shared ==="; grep -rno "viewTransition[^a-zA-Z]" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts | head
cd /workspace; grep -rlo "viewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/ 2>/dev/null | head -20

cd /workspace
echo "=== needsExperimentalReact ==="
cat node_modules/next/dist/server/dev/next-dev-server.js 2>/dev/null | grep -o "needsExperimentalReact" | head -1
find node_modules/next/dist -name "needs-experimental-react*" | head
cat node_modules/next/dist/lib/needs-experimental-react.js 2>/dev/null
echo "=== config schema grep for view ==="
grep -o "view[A-Za-z]*" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.js | sort -u | head -20

cd /workspace; grep -o "experimental\.[a-zA-Z]*" node_modules/next/dist/build/webpack-config.js | sort -u | head -40; echo "=== ViewTransition in next client ==="; grep -rlo "ViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/client/ node_modules/next/dist/shared/ 2>/dev/null | head -20

cd /workspace
echo "=== link.d.ts ViewTransition context ==="
grep -n -B5 -A10 "ViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.d.ts
echo ""
echo "=== app-router-context.d.ts ==="
grep -n -B8 -A8 "ViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/shared/lib/app-router-context.shared-runtime.d.ts

cd /workspace
echo "=== sanity: taint in config-schema ==="
grep -c "taint" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.js
echo "=== all 'view' occurrences in config-schema ==="
grep -oi "view[a-z]*" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.js | sort -u
echo "=== @types/react version ==="
node -e "console.log(require('./node_modules/@types/react/package.json').version)"
echo "=== ViewTransition in @types/react ==="
grep -rn "ViewTransition" node_modules/@types/react/*.d.ts | head -20
echo "=== addTransitionType in @types/react ==="
grep -rn "addTransitionType" node_modules/@types/react/*.d.ts | head

cd /workspace
echo "=== canary.d.ts head ==="
sed -n '1,45p' node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts
echo "=== how many ViewTransition occurrences in app-page dev runtime ==="
grep -o "ViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/next-server/app-page.runtime.dev.js | wc -l

cd /workspace
echo "=== declaration of ViewTransition component in canary.d.ts ==="
grep -n "const ViewTransition\|function ViewTransition\|ViewTransition:" node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts
echo "=== ViewTransitionProps fields ==="
sed -n '46,112p' node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts
echo "=== tsconfig ==="
cat tsconfig.json

cd /workspace
echo "=== react alias in webpack-config ==="
grep -o "'react\$'[^,]*\|\"react\\\$\"[^,]*" node_modules/next/dist/build/webpack-config.js | head -10
echo "--- getReactAliases / bundledReactChannel ---"
grep -o "bundledReactChannel[^,;)]*" node_modules/next/dist/build/webpack-config.js | head -5
echo "=== VIEW_TRANSITION in flight server (RSC serialization) ==="
grep -o "VIEW_TRANSITION\|view_transition" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-server-dom-webpack/cjs/react-server-dom-webpack-server.node.development.js | sort | uniq -c
echo "=== addTransitionType calls in app-page runtime ==="
grep -o "addTransitionType" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/next-server/app-page.runtime.dev.js | wc -l

cd /workspace
echo "=== VIEW_TRANSITION context in flight server ==="
grep -n -o ".\{160\}VIEW_TRANSITION.\{160\}" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-server-dom-webpack/cjs/react-server-dom-webpack-server.node.development.js
echo ""
echo "=== react alias ==="
grep -o "react: [^,]\{0,80\}\|'react': [^,]\{0,80\}" node_modules/next/dist/build/webpack-config.js | head -20
cd /workspace; grep -n -o ".\{120\}addTransitionType.\{120\}" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/next-server/app-page.runtime.dev.js | head -10

cd /workspace
echo "=== react\$ alias entries ==="
grep -o -e 'react\$[^,]\{0,90\}' node_modules/next/dist/build/webpack-config.js | head -12
echo "=== turbopack? which bundler default in next 16 ==="
grep -o -e 'react\$[^,]\{0,90\}' node_modules/next/dist/build/create-compiler-aliases.js 2>/dev/null | head -12
cd /workspace; grep -o -e '.\{100\}popstate.\{200\}' node_modules/next/dist/compiled/next-server/app-page.runtime.dev.js | head -5

cd /workspace
echo "=== RSC (react-server) build exports ViewTransition? ==="
node -e "
const r = require('./node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/cjs/react.react-server.development.js');
console.log('ViewTransition:', typeof r.ViewTransition, '| Suspense:', typeof r.Suspense, '| addTransitionType:', typeof r.addTransitionType);
"
echo "=== VIEW_TRANSITION occurrences in flight server ==="
grep -c "VIEW_TRANSITION" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-server-dom-webpack/cjs/react-server-dom-webpack-server.node.development.js
grep -o "REACT_VIEW_TRANSITION_TYPE[^;,)]\{0,60\}" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-server-dom-webpack/cjs/react-server-dom-webpack-server.node.development.js | head
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -40
npx tsc --noEmit --listFiles 2>/dev/null | grep -E "workspace/(app|types)" ; echo "--- exit: $? ---"
npx next build 2>&1 | tail -40

(npx next start -p 3111 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6; curl -s http://localhost:3111/ | head -c 1500; echo; echo "=== detail ==="; curl -s http://localhost:3111/product/leather-backpack | grep -o 'class="[^"]*"' | head -20

cd /workspace
F=node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-server.node.development.js
ls -la node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-dom/cjs/ | head -20
echo "=== search vt- attrs across react-dom builds ==="
grep -rlo '"vt-name"' node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-dom/cjs/ | head

cd /workspace
F=node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-server.node.development.js
echo "=== vt- attr emission in Fizz ==="
grep -n '"vt-' $F | head -20
echo ""
echo "=== function that pushes them ==="
grep -n -B30 '"vt-name"' $F | head -70

cd /workspace
F=node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-client.development.js
echo "=== getViewTransitionClassName ==="
grep -n -A26 "function getViewTransitionClassName" $F | head -60
echo ""
echo "=== per-type resolution helper ==="
grep -n -B2 -A22 "function getClassNameByType" $F | head -40

cd /workspace
FC=node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-client.development.js
echo "=== how 'none' className is applied (applyViewTransitionName / restore) ==="
grep -n -B3 -A16 "function applyViewTransitionName" $FC | head -40
echo ""
echo '=== callers checking "none" ==='
grep -n '"none" !== ' $FC | head -20

cd /workspace; grep -n -A14 "function getSuspenseViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-server.node.development.js | head -25; echo "=== pushViewTransitionAttributes full ==="; sed -n '1147,1172p' node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-server.node.development.js
cd /workspace; sed -n '14460,14480p;14540,14560p' node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-client.development.js

which google-chrome chromium chromium-browser 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; node -e "require.resolve('playwright')" 2>&1 | head -2; node -e "require.resolve('puppeteer')" 2>&1 | head -2

cd /workspace
echo "=== transitionTypes reach the client bundle? ==="
grep -rlo "vt-morph-image" .next/static/chunks/ 2>/dev/null | head
echo "=== forward/back types in client chunks ==="
grep -rlo "vt-page-forward" .next/static/chunks/ .next/static/ 2>/dev/null | head -3
echo "=== css emitted ==="
grep -o "view-transition-old(\.[a-z-]*)\|view-transition-group(\.[a-z-]*)\|view-transition-new(\.[a-z-]*)\|prefers-reduced-motion:reduce\|view-transition-image-pair([^)]*)" .next/static/chunks/*.css | sort -u

cd /workspace
echo "=== reduced-motion block as shipped ==="
grep -o "@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){[^@]*}}" .next/static/chunks/*.css | head -c 900
echo; echo "=== RSC payload for detail page (view transition markers) ==="
curl -s -H 'RSC: 1' http://localhost:3111/product/leather-backpack | grep -o '"\$Y"\|view_transition\|vt-morph-image\|vt-reveal\|product-image-leather-backpack' | sort | uniq -c

cd /workspace; curl -s -D /tmp/h.txt -H 'RSC: 1' http://localhost:3111/product/leather-backpack -o /tmp/rsc.txt; head -3 /tmp/h.txt; wc -c /tmp/rsc.txt; grep -o "view_transition\|product-image-leather-backpack\|vt-morph-image\|vt-reveal\|product-hero" /tmp/rsc.txt | sort | uniq -c

cd /workspace; curl -s -H 'RSC: 1' 'http://localhost:3111/product/leather-backpack?_rsc=abc' -o /tmp/rsc.txt; wc -c /tmp/rsc.txt; grep -o "view_transition\|product-image-leather-backpack\|vt-morph-image\|vt-reveal\|product-hero\|vt-page-forward" /tmp/rsc.txt | sort | uniq -c

cd /workspace; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3111/ ; tail -5 /tmp/next.log; curl -s -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-State-Tree: %5B%22%22%2C%7B%22children%22%3A%5B%22__PAGE__%22%2C%7B%7D%5D%7D%2Cnull%2Cnull%2Ctrue%5D' 'http://localhost:3111/product/leather-backpack?_rsc=abc' | head -c 300

cd /workspace
echo "=== transitionTypes serialized into the page's flight payload ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3111/ | grep -o 'transitionTypes[^,]*' | head -4
echo "=== detail page: hero + suspense wrapper attrs ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3111/product/leather-backpack | grep -o '<main[^>]*>\|<div class="product-hero"[^>]*>\|<div class="product-info"[^>]*>\|transitionTypes[^,]*' | head

cd /workspace
curl -s http://localhost:3111/ | grep -o 'vt-name="product-image-[a-z-]*"' 
pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null
echo "=== git status ==="
git status --short
echo "=== tsconfig diff (Next auto-edit) ==="
git diff tsconfig.json
cat .gitignore
cd /workspace; git status --short; echo "=== tsconfig diff ==="; git diff tsconfig.json; echo "=== gitignore ==="; cat .gitignore
cd /workspace; git checkout tsconfig.json && rm -rf .next tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && git status --short
cd /workspace; git diff -- app/ | head -120
cd /workspace; git diff -- "app/product/[slug]/page.tsx"
ls -la /home/vercel-sandbox/.claude/projects/-workspace/memory/ 2>&1; cat /home/vercel-sandbox/.claude/projects/-workspace/memory/MEMORY.md 2>/dev/null
